terms.meaning: A focused Principia review has checked the declared scope; the artifact is not automatically complete, released, or Atlas-reviewed.
A Principia pedagogical lifecycle state controlled by Principia governance; it does not follow from software, bridge, release, or Atlas status.
Principia publication readiness, independent of pedagogical status and Atlas knowledge status.
A positive exact Principia revision that changes when dependency-relevant meaning changes.
A dependency reference to one immutable integer revision, never a mutable label such as latest.
A purpose-bounded representation with assumptions, variables, parameters, evidence, and limitations; not the system itself.
A claim requiring an identification strategy, intervention, mechanism, or other justified causal evidence; correlation alone is insufficient.
A conserved accounting quantity whose transfers and stores depend on a declared system boundary; energy is not a material substance and is not simply released by breaking bonds.
Rate of energy transfer or conversion, measured in watts, distinct from energy measured in joules or watt-hours.
Useful output divided by declared input for a stated boundary, operating condition, and time interval.
Ability to preserve or recover a defined service under declared disturbances; not a synonym for reliability, redundancy, or autonomy.
A quantified or qualitatively bounded limitation on measurement, inference, model, forecast, or decision; not automatically equivalent to ignorance or random error.
Fraction of a declared observation interval in which a defined service meets stated conditions; the boundary and excluded events must be explicit.

A revision-pinned Principia–Atlas importer candidate with live set to false. It carries exact dependency identity but creates no operational call, lifecycle inheritance, or cross-repository status authority.
